name: Conjure Woodland Beings

targets.description: creatures you can see that the Emanation reaches, that enter it or that end their turn in it

sustain.label: Disengage (nature spirits)
sustain.help: While the spirits surround you, you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.

summary: 10-foot aura of nature spirits: Wis save, 5d8 Force (half on a success); Disengage as a Bonus Action.
text: Nature spirits flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see, and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save no more than once per turn. For the duration you can also take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action. Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
